    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersPumpkin King pastiesRoast pumpkin, feta and sage in crimped pastry with a jack-o'-lantern faceHow to make it600g pumpkin, diced1 tbsp olive oil100g feta, crumbled1 tbsp fresh sage, chopped1 pinch of nutmeg3 sheets of shortcrust pastry1 egg, beatenHeat the oven to 200°C. Roast the pumpkin in oil until soft.Mash with the feta, sage and nutmeg and cool.Cut the pastry into rounds, fill and fold into half moons.Cut a little jack o'lantern face into each and brush with egg.Bake until golden.Christmas Town candy cane cheese twistsThe bright Christmas Town Jack stumbles intoHow to make itAs written, serves 4Puff pastry twisted into candy cane hooks, half coated in smoked paprika and parmesan for the red stripes, baked crisp with a tomato relish dip.Heat the oven to 200°C.Brush 2 sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg.Scatter one sheet with 60g grated parmesan and 2 tsp smoked paprika and leave the other plain with a little cheddar.Cut both into 1cm strips.Twist a red strip and a plain strip together, bend the top into a hook and lay on lined trays.Bake 14 minutes until golden.Serve with tomato relish.Spiced roast pumpkin seedsWhat's this? What's this? Jack's first taste.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsSally's soupRoast pumpkin and carrot soup with a sour cream spiderweb on topHow to make it1kg pumpkin, cut in chunks3 carrots, chopped3 cloves of garlic1 tsp fresh thyme2 tbsp olive oil1 L hot chicken stock150ml sour creamHeat the oven to 200°C. Roast the pumpkin, carrots, garlic and thyme in oil until soft.Blend with the hot stock until smooth.Pour into bowls.Pipe circles of sour cream on top and drag a skewer from the centre outwards to make a spiderweb.Halloween Town beef and pumpkin stewThe town square cauldronHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef shin braised dark with pumpkin, carrot, smoked paprika and stock until spoon-soft, served from a black pot with crusty bread.Brown 1.2kg diced beef shin in batches.Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves.Return the beef, add 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 litre beef stock, cover and simmer 2 hours.Add 600g pumpkin chunks and simmer 40 minutes more.Serve with crusty bread and a spoon of sour cream.SweetsOogie Boogie chocolate mousse dirt cupsChocolate mousse under crushed cookie dirt with gummy wormsHow to make it200g dark chocolate300ml thickened cream3 eggs, separated8 chocolate biscuits, crushed1 handful of gummy wormsMelt the chocolate and cool slightly.Whip the cream and whisk the egg whites to soft peaks.Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites.Spoon into cups and chill.Cover with crushed biscuits and push in gummy worms.Zero's ghost dog meringuesCrisp piped meringue ghosts with a dot of red icing for the noseHow to make it3 egg whites1 pinch of cream of tartar170g caster sugar1 tube red icingHeat the oven to 100°C and line trays. Whisk the egg whites with the cream of tartar to stiff peaks.Add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Pipe ghostly teardrops onto the trays.Bake for 90 minutes.Cool and add a dot of red icing for the nose.DrinksWitch's cauldron blackcurrant apple punchWarm apple and blackcurrant juice simmered with cinnamon, star anise and clovesHow to make it1.2 L cloudy apple juice300ml blackcurrant juice2 cinnamon sticks, for simmering3 star anises6 whole cloves1 strip of orange peel4 cinnamon sticks, to servePour the apple and blackcurrant juice into a pot with the cinnamon sticks, star anise, cloves and orange peel.Bring to a simmer and keep just below simmering.Ladle into mugs with a cinnamon stick.Warm pumpkin spice milkJack's Christmas experiments need a warm cup.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
